notes.title: GamesCom 2015
notes.content:
Hey everyone. 

As the main community team is leaving for GamesCom 2015 tomorrow. We will be unable to respond to questions as fast as we normally do, we will try and respond within reasonable time however no promises.

If you are going to GamesCom 2015 yourself come find us in the indie arena and get a preview on one of our new titles as well as talk to us about our other games. 

Hope to see you all there. 

//BFG Zyddie

notes.title: Windows 8/8.1 performance fix + French localizaion
notes.content:
Dear players,

Fixed the issue when the game refused to play nice with Windows 8/8.1, was related to how Windows 8/8.q2 handles color palette emulation. Thanks to Filip Frackiewicz and the team it's fixed now.

Additionally, we have added French translation to the list of supported languages.

Cheers,
BFG Team

notes.title: German language support for Airline Tycoon Deluxe
notes.content:
Liebe Fans,

wir haben das Spiel mit deutscher Sprachunterstützung erweitert. Lasst uns bitte wissen, wenn es Probleme mit der Übersetzung gibt – wir kümmern uns drum.

MfG,
das BFG-Team

Dear fans,

We’ve added “ze German” language support to the game. Please let us know if there are problems with the translation, so we can fix them.

Cheers,
Your BFG Team

notes.title: Linux and Mac versions are available now
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have been listening to your comments and noticed that some of you ask to add Linux and Mac support. 

From now on, Linux and Mac versions of Airline Tycoon Deluxe are available in the store.

Cheers,
Your BFG Team
